name: Nono
source:
A shrine maiden-in-training who takes her training seriously. She cleans and takes care of the shrine. She also tries to do fortune telling in the city, though she is infamous for getting her fortunes wrong. 
She is the first major character [url=/c12299]Chris[/url] is introduced to in the game. At first she does not seem to be fond of him because of his slacker mentality, but eventually she learns to like him.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Nono]Wikipedia[/url].]
